# External Reference Documents

Place external reference documents (org charts, governance structures, policy PDFs, existing stakeholder maps, statutory guidance) here. ArcKit commands will read these to inform analysis.

Useful documents to drop here for the PRS Database project:
- Renters' Rights Act 2025 Part 2 explanatory notes
- MHCLG organisational chart and digital portfolio governance
- Local Government Association housing enforcement memos
- Existing local authority licensing scheme documentation
- PRS Ombudsman scheme rules (once published)
